stages.title: PF2 · Advanced capstone specifications
stages.focus: Use the source blueprint's two deep technical builds.

modules.title: Capstone A · Multi-cloud failover
modules.description: Prove a controlled regional failover design.
topics: AWS EKS and Azure AKS environment model
Terraform or OpenTofu modules for both cloud foundations
Three-zone network segmentation and CIDR planning
Cross-cloud private connectivity with BGP / IPsec or an encrypted overlay
Federated workload identity and External Secrets integration
CockroachDB quorum or Aurora Global plus outbox design
Database replication, consistency and quorum behavior
Route 53 deep readiness checks and global traffic routing
Controlled regional ingress-loss simulation in an isolated lab
Measured RTO, RPO and data integrity
modules.lab: Build the multi-cloud topology in isolated environments, then exercise a controlled regional failure. Record health-check behavior, client impact, database consistency and recovery evidence.
modules.gate: Show the architecture decision record, security model, dependency map and an observed failover result. State the test assumptions; do not claim zero data loss unless you measured and validated it.

modules.title: Capstone B · Financial telemetry engine
modules.description: Prove event-driven processing and observability.
topics: Idempotency key design and duplicate-request handling
Partitioning by account or merchant for ordered events
Redis risk-score cache and dead-letter queue
Trace context propagation across stream records
P95/P99 latency, throughput and saturation testing
modules.lab: Load-test a controlled event stream, inject duplicate and malformed messages, and observe the ledger, consumer lag, DLQ and trace chain.
modules.gate: Demonstrate idempotent processing, explain ordering guarantees and limits, and publish measured throughput and latency with test methodology.
